title: Sign-out ends the session on the server: a copied tracy_sess cookie no longer signs in or renews, while sessions minted before the change keep working until they expire
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/session-revocation.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/session.test.mjs
S2: Read the lines for the tests named in expect.
expect: 'a cookie used after sign-out no longer signs anyone in' is ok: GET /auth/me with the cookie answers the email, POST /auth/signout with it answers 200, the same cookie on GET /auth/me then answers email null (pre-fix: still the email, for up to 72 h).
'a signed-out session cannot be renewed back to life' is ok: after sign-out and more than an hour, GET /auth/me answers email null and sets no cookie.
'a renewed cookie belongs to the same sign-in' is ok: signing out with the pre-renewal cookie also ends the renewed one.
'signing out one sign-in leaves another sign-in of the same person alone' is ok.
'a token minted before jti existed is still accepted until it expires' is ok, and 'renewing an old jti-less token hands out one that sign-out can end' is ok.
'the wire format is the one every signed-in browser is already holding' is ok.
evidence: E2E 04/10/2026 J1.3 (tasks/evidence/e2e-full-dev/2026-10-04): an old tracy_sess cookie still signed in after POST /auth/signout on cowork.tracy.site.
fence: Every token carries a jti kept across renewals; sign-out writes it to session_revocation (memory book without a database); every read of the cookie through lib/session.js refuses a revoked jti, so every door and the renewal in /auth/me refuse it. jti-less tokens are not revocable and expire on their own clock.

tests: a cookie used after sign-out no longer signs anyone in
a signed-out session cannot be renewed back to life
a renewed cookie belongs to the same sign-in
signing out one sign-in leaves another sign-in of the same person alone
a token minted before jti existed is still accepted until it expires
renewing an old jti-less token hands out one that sign-out can end
the wire format is the one every signed-in browser is already holding
